comment: Task 02 identity prototypes: structural params (head/skull/jaw/cheek/ears via gaussian fields) + drawn-feature params (eye/brow/nose/lip transforms on V59_* ink layers). Same file drives both genders; each set is a different person, not a rescaled baseline.

mira.desc: Long oval face, high forehead, narrow chin; large round wide-set eyes, thin high-arched brows, narrow short nose, wide mouth, small ears.

thea.desc: Round broad face, low forehead, full cheeks, soft jaw; close-set almond eyes, thick straight low brows, broad nose, full lips, larger ears.

rhea.desc: Angular square face, strong jaw and chin, prominent brow ridge; narrow deep-set eyes, thick angled brows, long projecting nose, thin lips.
